name: Blueberries
description: Blueberries are a premium, physiologically active botanical berry matrix. Celebrated for their low-calorie profile, they hold an exceptional concentration of water-soluble polyphenols, specifically *anthocyanins* like malvidin and delphinidin. Bound within an unrefined whole-food crystalline matrix, these compounds cross the blood-brain barrier to drive neuroprotective signaling, neutralize advanced systemic oxidative stress loops, and actively reinforce peripheral vascular elasticity.
macroIntro: The macronutrient configuration of raw blueberries provides an exceptionally light, hyper-hydrating framework designed to export massive payloads of active organic compounds with minimal glycemic impact.
microIntro: Blueberries house a sophisticated, highly bioavailable cluster of natural protective pigments, vital organic acids, and enzymatic cofactors tailored to shield DNA structures from oxidative decay.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: An incredibly low caloric density that allows for optimal consumption volume while delivering a massive ratio of therapeutic micronutrients per calorie.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Contains trace, easily assimilable botanical amino acid fragments essential for basic maintenance within the structural plant tissue.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Virtually lipid-free, keeping global dietary fat parameters strictly unburdened while favoring the immediate absorption of water-soluble molecules.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Composed of low-glycemic, slow-fusing natural fruit sugars tightly bundled within an unrefined, highly functional pectin fiber network.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
microNutrients.description: Provides steady plant-derived ascorbic acid that acts in synergy with native flavonoids to reinforce dermal collagen matrices and support immune cell motility.

microNutrients.name: Anthocyanins (Polyphenols)
microNutrients.description: Powerful, intensely active lipophilic and hydrophilic pigments that give the berry its signature deep blue hue and drive unmatched radical-scavenging dynamics.

healthBenefits: Advanced Neuroprotection & Cognitive Drive: Highly mobile *anthocyanins* effectively breach the blood-brain barrier, accumulating in the hippocampus to stimulate optimal neuroplasticity, enhance spatial memory, and delay age-related cognitive decline.

Systemic Free-Radical Eradication: The high baseline density of natural polyphenols works continuously to intercept reactive oxygen species (ROS), protecting delicate cellular membranes and DNA strands from advanced oxidative mutations.

Vascular Integrity & Endothelial Support: Active plant compounds stimulate endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS), inducing smooth vasodilation, lowering peripheral arterial pressure, and reducing oxidized LDL accumulation.

Metabolic Insulin Sensitivity Enhancement: Unique biochemical pathways within the berry's organic structure assist skeletal muscle receptors in clean glucose clearing, preventing aggressive postprandial insulin spikes.
precautionsIntro: While raw blueberries represent an exceptionally safe and highly therapeutic dietary asset, their chemical concentration and cultivation traits require deliberate consumption parameters.
precautions: Potential Tree/Berry Allergenic Pathways: Though clinically rare, sensitive individuals may experience immunoglobulin E (IgE) mediated hypersensitivity cascades or oral allergy syndrome driven by botanical salicylate compounds.

Carbohydrate Monitoring in Advanced Diabetes: While the glycemic index remains low, the baseline fruit sugar volume must still be calculated into the global daily carbohydrate allowance for individuals managing strict metabolic disorders.

Pesticide Residue Accumulation Vector: Due to the fragile, porous nature of the berry's outer skin, conventional crops frequently retain surface agricultural chemical residues. Prioritizing organic sourcing or thorough ultrasonic washing is highly required.

Gastrointestinal Hyper-Motility: Consuming extreme volumes of raw blueberries can introduce an abrupt influx of natural fruit acids and insoluble fiber fractions, occasionally triggering temporary osmotic diarrhea or abdominal bloating.
